records.jp: そういえば、こっちに来てから<CR>ラジオとか聞いてないなー
records.en_original: Now that I think about it, I haven't listened to the radio since I came here.
records.en: Now that I think about it, I haven't listened to the radio since I came here.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん、どんなの聞いてたの？
records.en_original: What kind of things do you listen to, Ao?
records.en: What kind of things do you listen to, Ao?

records.jp: 声優さんの深夜ラジオ聞いてたんだけど<CR>ミニドラマがめっちゃ面白くてさ
records.en_original: Mostly late-night programs with voice actors. The mini-dramas were super fun!
records.en: Mostly late-night programs with voice actors. The mini-dramas were super fun!

records.jp: ミニドラマ？
records.en_original: Mini-dramas?
records.en: Mini-dramas?

records.jp: ゲストさんと二人で、色んなシチュエーションの<CR>短編をその場で演じるんだよ
records.en_original: The host asks viewers for suggestions then acts them out with the guest.
records.en: The host asks viewers for suggestions then acts them out with the guest.

records.jp: へぇ～！　その場で演じるって<CR>すごい難しそうだよね
records.en_original: Ohhh. That sounds like it'd be tough!
records.en: Ohhh. That sounds like it'd be tough!

records.jp: でも、ちょっとやってみたいかも……
records.en_original: But it does sound like fun...
records.en: But it does sound like fun...

records.jp: だったら、二人でやってみない？
records.en_original: Want to try one out with me?
records.en: Want to try one out with me?

records.jp: えっ？<CR>それって、放送するってこと？
records.en_original: Huh? Like, try broadcasting it?
records.en: Huh? Like, try broadcasting it?

records.jp: そうそう！　やるなら、みんなに<CR>聞いてもらいたいじゃん！
records.en_original: Yeah! If we're going to do it, then I want everyone to hear!
records.en: Yeah! If we're going to do it, then I want everyone to hear!

records.jp: 私、演技なんてしたことないよ！？<CR>それに、愛央ちゃんみたいに可愛い声でもないし
records.en_original: But I've never acted in anything before! And I don't even have a cute voice like you, Ao...
records.en: But I've never acted in anything before! And I don't even have a cute voice like you, Ao...

records.jp: 何言ってんの！<CR>陽桜莉さんの声、めっちゃ可愛いから！
records.en_original: What are you talking about? Your voice is super cute!
records.en: What are you talking about? Your voice is super cute!

records.jp: 毎朝、起こされたいぐらい<CR>癒しのボイスだから！！
records.en_original: It's the kind of voice I'd love to wake up to each morning!
records.en: It's the kind of voice I'd love to wake up to each morning!

records.jp: そ、そう？　愛央ちゃんが<CR>そこまで言うなら、やってみようかなぁ
records.en_original: R-really? I guess I have to give it a try if you say that...
records.en: R-really? I guess I have to give it a try if you say that...

records.jp: 私も、演技とかしたことないけど<CR>面白そうだよね！
records.en_original: I've never acted either, but it seems fun!
records.en: I've never acted either, but it seems fun!

records.jp: うんうん。声だけでいいのなら<CR>私にもできそうな気がするよ
records.en_original: Yeah. If it's just our voices, then I think I could maybe do it.
records.en: Yeah. If it's just our voices, then I think I could maybe do it.

records.jp: ……やってみちゃう？
records.en_original: ...Wanna try?
records.en: ...Wanna try?

records.jp: えっ？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: 放送室を自由に使えるなんて、今だけだよ！<CR>これを逃したら、もうチャンスはないかも！
records.en_original: It's not every day that we get a whole broadcasting room to ourself! We have to take advantage of this!
records.en: It's not every day that we get a whole broadcasting room to ourself! We have to take advantage of this!

records.jp: た、たしかに……！<CR>やるなら、今しかない！
records.en_original: Y-you're right! This may be the only chance we get!
records.en: Y-you're right! This may be the only chance we get!

records.jp: よっしゃ、決まり！<CR>いやー。陽桜莉さんのノリ、大好き！
records.en_original: Okay, I'm ready! I love that you're into this!
records.en: Okay, I'm ready! I love that you're into this!

records.jp: あはは！<CR>私も、愛央ちゃんの行動力好きだよ
records.en_original: Ahaha! And I love your initiative!
records.en: Ahaha! And I love your initiative!

records.jp: でも、何をやればいいのかな？<CR>台本とか、いるよね
records.en_original: How do we go about this, anyways? Don't we need a script?
records.en: How do we go about this, anyways? Don't we need a script?

records.jp: んー……図書室で本借りてくる？
records.en_original: Hmm... Why don't we borrow a book from the library?
records.en: Hmm... Why don't we borrow a book from the library?

records.jp: あ、それいいかも！<CR>ジャンルはどうする？
records.en_original: Good idea! What genre should we go with?
records.en: Good idea! What genre should we go with?

records.jp: ほのぼのした話がいいな<CR>可愛くて、明るい感じのやつ
records.en_original: How about a heartwarming story? I could go for something cute and fun.
records.en: How about a heartwarming story? I could go for something cute and fun.

records.jp: うん、賛成！　絵本なんてどう？<CR>短くて、読みやすいんじゃない？
records.en_original: Agreed! How about a picture book? Those are short and simple.
records.en: Agreed! How about a picture book? Those are short and simple.

records.jp: おお、ナイスアイディア！
records.en_original: Sounds perfect!
records.en: Sounds perfect!

records.jp: 怖い話がいいな！<CR>背筋がぞ～っとするようなやつ！
records.en_original: Let's do something scary! A story that gives you goosebumps!
records.en: Let's do something scary! A story that gives you goosebumps!

records.jp: いきなり放送して、みんなびっくりしないかな？
records.en_original: I wonder if we'd bother anyone by using the broadcasting equipment...
records.en: I wonder if we'd bother anyone by using the broadcasting equipment...

records.jp: あー……<CR>中には怖い話が苦手な人もいるか
records.en_original: Oh... I know a couple of the girls aren't a fan of horror, either.
records.en: Oh... I know a couple of the girls aren't a fan of horror, either.

records.jp: 子供向けの絵本とかはどう？<CR>短いし、読みやすいと思うんだけど
records.en_original: How about a picture book? Those are short and simple.
records.en: How about a picture book? Those are short and simple.

records.jp: あ、それいいかも！<CR>絵本なら、苦手な人あんまいないだろうし
records.en_original: Oh, that sounds good! I think everyone could get into that.
records.en: Oh, that sounds good! I think everyone could get into that.

records.jp: じゃあ、さっそく借りてこよ！
records.en_original: Well, let's go find our book!
records.en: Well, let's go find our book!

records.jp: 「――クロ、やっと会えたね！<CR>ずっとずっと、探していたんだよ」
records.en_original: "Kuro, I'm so happy to see you again! I never stopped looking for you."
records.en: "Kuro, I'm so happy to see you again! I never stopped looking for you."

records.jp: 「ボクは、いつも君の側にいたよ。<CR>ただ、姿が見えなかっただけ……」
records.en_original: "I was always with you. You just couldn't see me..."
records.en: "I was always with you. You just couldn't see me..."

records.jp: 「寂しい時は、ボクの名前を呼んで。<CR>そして、思い出して。ボクのことを」
records.en_original: "Whenever you're lonely, just say my name, and remember me."
records.en: "Whenever you're lonely, just say my name, and remember me."

records.jp: 「うん。これでもう、寂しくない。<CR>ありがとうクロ、大好きだよ……」
records.en_original: "Okay. I'll never be lonely again. I love you, Kuro..."
records.en: "Okay. I'll never be lonely again. I love you, Kuro..."

records.jp: ……ふーっ、緊張したぁ！<CR>私、ちゃんと出来てたかな？
records.en_original: Phew! Boy, was I nervous. Did I do okay?
records.en: Phew! Boy, was I nervous. Did I do okay?

records.jp: 出来てたよ！　てか、陽桜莉さん<CR>めちゃくちゃ上手かった！
records.en_original: You weren't just okay, you were great!
records.en: You weren't just okay, you were great!

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんこそ！<CR>クロ、すっごく可愛かった！
records.en_original: You too, Ao! Your Kuro was so adorable!
records.en: You too, Ao! Your Kuro was so adorable!

records.jp: えへへ、ありがとう
records.en_original: Ehehe, thanks!
records.en: Ehehe, thanks!

records.jp: この絵本、良いお話だったね。<CR>ちょっと、切ないけどさ
records.en_original: Isn't this story nice? Even if it was a little sad.
records.en: Isn't this story nice? Even if it was a little sad.

records.jp: うん……そうだね。<CR>男の子と、死んじゃった黒猫のお話
records.en_original: Yeah. A tale of a little boy and his late black cat.
records.en: Yeah. A tale of a little boy and his late black cat.

records.jp: 私、二人が夢の中で再会するシーンが大好きで<CR>この絵本、何度も読んだんだよね
records.en_original: I love the scene where they reunite in a dream. I've read this one so many times.
records.en: I love the scene where they reunite in a dream. I've read this one so many times.

records.jp: えっ。<CR>この絵本、陽桜莉さんの愛読書だったんだ！
records.en_original: Oh, you know it?
records.en: Oh, you know it?

records.jp: 私とお姉ちゃん、どっちも好きだよ。<CR>昔お姉ちゃんに、よく読んでもらってたんだ
records.en_original: It was a favorite of both Mio and I. She used to read it to me a long time ago.
records.en: It was a favorite of both Mio and I. She used to read it to me a long time ago.

records.jp: そっか……<CR>二人の思い出のお話なんだね
records.en_original: Huh... You must both have a lot of memories with it.
records.en: Huh... You must both have a lot of memories with it.

records.jp: お姉ちゃんも<CR>今の放送聞いてくれてたかな？
records.en_original: Do you think Mio listened to our broadcast?
records.en: Do you think Mio listened to our broadcast?

records.jp: うん、全校内に流れてたはずだから
records.en_original: Well, it should have been played all over the whole school.
records.en: Well, it should have been played all over the whole school.

records.jp: お姉ちゃん、どう思ったかなぁ
records.en_original: I wonder if she liked it.
records.en: I wonder if she liked it.

records.jp: 楽しんでくれたんじゃないかな？<CR>私は、めちゃくちゃ楽しかったし！
records.en_original: I bet she did. I know I had fun acting it!
records.en: I bet she did. I know I had fun acting it!

records.jp: ふふっ……実は私も！
records.en_original: Hehe... I did too!
records.en: Hehe... I did too!

records.jp: ドキドキしたけど、声を出すって<CR>なんか気持ちいいね
records.en_original: I was pretty nervous at first, but it actually felt pretty good.
records.en: I was pretty nervous at first, but it actually felt pretty good.

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんが良ければ、また一緒にやろうよ
records.en_original: We should do this again sometime.
records.en: We should do this again sometime.

records.jp: うん、もちろん！
records.en_original: Of course!
records.en: Of course!

records.jp: 本人に聞いてみたら？
records.en_original: Why don't you ask her?
records.en: Why don't you ask her?

records.jp: え～！　それは、なんか緊張する！
records.en_original: Huh? I'd be way too nervous for that!
records.en: Huh? I'd be way too nervous for that!

records.jp: 美弦さんのことだから、演技のダメ出しとか<CR>すごいされそうだよね……
records.en_original: Mio does kind of seem like the type of person to nitpick...
records.en: Mio does kind of seem like the type of person to nitpick...

records.jp: 「２ページ目のクロのセリフだけど、<CR>感情が入っていなかったわ」……とか？
records.en_original: "I don't think you quite captured the full range of Kuro's emotions in this line."
records.en: "I don't think you quite captured the full range of Kuro's emotions in this line."

records.jp: あはは、似てる！　さすが、姉妹！
records.en_original: Ahaha, that sounds just like her!
records.en: Ahaha, that sounds just like her!

records.jp: うふふ♪
records.en_original: Hehehe!
records.en: Hehehe!

records.jp: どうしたの？
records.en_original: What's wrong?
records.en: What's wrong?

records.jp: 放送……切れてなかった
records.en_original: I never turned off the broadcast...
records.en: I never turned off the broadcast...

records.jp: えっ……
records.en_original: Wha...
records.en: Wha...

records.jp: 今の、美弦さんにも聞こえたかも……
records.en_original: I think Mio may have heard everything we just said...
records.en: I think Mio may have heard everything we just said...

records.jp: えええええ～～！！！
records.en_original: Noooooo!!
records.en: Noooooo!!

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
